mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, it predicts a near-term increase in risk-free discounting of equities, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment growth) of at least 50,000 jobs is associated with stronger consumer demand and higher S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, returns are negative or flat despite the monthly PAYEMS increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the 2-month moving average of HOUST (retail sales) exceeds 2000 units, it signals resilient consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative even when HOUST MA(2) > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of more than 5% indicates supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite INDPRO contraction exceeding threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE above 0.2% suggest conflicting policy signals, resulting in negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive when both proxies meet the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in RSAFS (retail sales in millions) below 350,000 coincides with a weakening demand environment and negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when RSAFS falls below threshold.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL (CPI) rises by more than 0.5% in a month, it reflects upward price pressure that reduces real equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive during the CPI acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in GDPC1 (GDP) above 2% for three consecutive months is associated with a strong economic recovery and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive during the 3-month expansion window (p > 0.05).
